rationale: The Latin anchors exsurgere, resurgere, and surgere all mean "to rise up / stand up," and the Old English a-standan means "to stand up, arise." None of the candidate synsets capture this sense of rising/standing up precisely; 'arrive.v.01' is the closest in conveying directed movement/change of position, but the true sense is better reflected by 'historical_unmapped' since no candidate matches "to rise, stand up."
